Light boots since 10-22: a median of 62K (26 boots). The light boot of 00:22 on 11-16 took 90K with the held list read whole. The light boot of 13:32 took the context from 129K to 191K and read 44 of the held list's 420 lines (`C:16897`).
- The floor: the first call after a compaction already holds a median of 120K (93K to 138K): the summary, the system prompt, and what the harness re-attaches. The re-attached skills are 84K characters, about 29K tokens: the two project cores cut at 20K characters each, which the boot then loads again whole, and `update-config` and `artifact-design` at 20K characters each.
- After a full boot he sent a median of 8 messages before the next compaction (15 boots since 10-22); after a light boot, 17 (25 boots).
- A side finding: each load of the `fortress-repo` skill also attaches `Library/FlatString.fss` (6K characters), because the skill's text quotes a cache entry that starts `@"/home/user/fortress/Library/FlatString.fss"` and the harness reads that as a file mention (`C:13891`).

**Index.** `boot_cost.py --boot C:16094` and `--boot C:16815` print the two boots of today call by call with the context after each call.

**What it cannot show.** What each file in context is worth. Section 3 gives one number for it: corrections of kinds 1, 2 and 7 at 4.8 per 100 of his messages without FACTS and POSITIONS whole, against 1.0 with them.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Checks explorations/coordinator/INDEX.md against the tree: which standalone
# notes are missing a line, which lines name a file that is gone, which lines
# fall outside the set the index is meant to cover, and which paths named in a
# line's prose no longer resolve. Read-only. Exit 1 if the first two are
# non-empty.
#
# The note set is every *.md under explorations/ except run/experiment trees
# (which document themselves in their own README) and evidence directories.
# Edit the two lists below when the shape of the tree changes.

set -uo pipefail

root=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)
index="$root/explorations/coordinator/INDEX.md"
[ -f "$index" ] || { echo "no INDEX.md at $index" >&2; exit 2; }

# Run/experiment trees: a directory holding one run's sources and evidence.
run_roots='apl|astra|blinded-fable|compile-ladder|run-b|run-b2|run-c|run-c3|run-c4|fortify|ci|experiment'
# Generic evidence directory names, at any depth.
evidence_dirs='probes|checks|goldens|figures|evidence|measurements|raw|src|tools|gate|cold-cache|reference|archive|build|article|worker|notes|recovered-reports|_prior|__pycache__|existing-tests|failed|png|regen|tic-regen|tour|pairs|combos'

notes=$(cd "$root" && find explorations -name '*.md' \
  | grep -vE "(^|/)[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+-(probes|pairs)/" \
  | grep -vE "(^|/)($evidence_dirs)/" \
  | grep -vE "^explorations/($run_roots)/" \
  | grep -v '^explorations/coordinator/INDEX.md$' \
  | sort)

# Entry keys: the backticked path at the start of an index bullet.
keys=$(grep -oP '^- `\K[^`]+' "$index" | sort -u)
# Entry keys that are notes (drop the .js/.sh entries from the comparison set).
key_notes=$(printf '%s\n' "$keys" | grep '\.md$' | sort -u)

missing=$(comm -23 <(printf '%s\n' "$notes") <(printf '%s\n' "$key_notes"))
stale=$(printf '%s\n' "$keys" | while read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] && [ ! -e "$root/$p" ] && echo "$p"
done)
outside=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$notes") <(printf '%s\n' "$key_notes"))

tracked=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$tracked"' EXIT
(cd "$root" && git ls-files) > "$tracked" 2>/dev/null || : > "$tracked"

# Paths named inside a line's prose (not the entry key) that resolve nowhere.
dangling=$(grep -oP '`\K[^`]{1,120}?\.(md|js|sh|py|fss|fsi|html|tic|svg|csv|tsv|txt|yml)(?=`)' "$index" \
  | grep '/' | grep -v '[[:space:]]' | sort -u | while read -r p; do
    if [ -e "$root/$p" ] || [ -e "$root/explorations/$p" ] \
       || [ -e "$root/explorations/coordinator/$p" ]; then continue; fi
    # last resort: the reference may be relative to a directory deeper in the tree
    grep -q "/$p\$" "$tracked" || echo "$p"
  done)

n() { [ -z "$1" ] && echo 0 || printf '%s\n' "$1" | wc -l | tr -d ' '; }

echo "INDEX.md check — $(cd "$root" && git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 'no git')"
echo "notes in scope: $(n "$notes")   index entries: $(n "$keys")"
echo
echo "== notes missing from INDEX.md ($(n "$missing")) =="
[ -n "$missing" ] && printf '%s\n' "$missing"
echo
echo "== index lines naming a file that does not exist ($(n "$stale")) =="
[ -n "$stale" ] && printf '%s\n' "$stale"
echo
echo "== index lines outside the note set, informational ($(n "$outside")) =="
[ -n "$outside" ] && printf '%s\n' "$outside"
echo
echo "== paths named in a line's prose that resolve nowhere ($(n "$dangling")) =="
[ -n "$dangling" ] && printf '%s\n' "$dangling"

[ -n "$missing" ] || [ -n "$stale" ] && exit 1
exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# Switches the workflow scripts and the headless writers between the two tier settings:
#   regular  the tiers of the coordinator skill's references/delegating.md (Opus workers, Sonnet scouts,
#            Fable for a judge's second ruling), and the headless writers on Opus;
#   fable    every agent on Fable, at medium effort where it ran on Opus and at low effort where it ran
#            on Sonnet, and the headless writers on Fable at medium effort.
# It edits the one switch line of each file (FABLE_WEEK in the three workflow scripts, WRITER_MODEL and
# WRITER_EFFORT in tiers.sh), checks the batch script, and commits nothing.
#
#   tier-mode.sh status     print the setting of each file
#   tier-mode.sh fable      set every file to the Fable setting
#   tier-mode.sh regular    set every file to the regular setting
#
# Do not switch while a workflow runs: a resume needs the script as launched (the coordinator skill's
# references/delegating.md, "Interrupts and process stops"). After a switch: commit the four files by name.
# The tier of an Agent-tool worker is not set here: the coordinator names it in each launch.
set -euo pipefail
here=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
scripts=("$here/../climb-batch-workflow.js" "$here/record-landing/record-landing.js" "$here/orientation/orientation.js")
tiers="$here/tiers.sh"

status() {
  for f in "${scripts[@]}"; do
    n=$(grep -c '^const FABLE_WEEK = \(true\|false\)$' "$f" || true)
    [ "$n" = 1 ] || { echo "tier-mode: $f has $n switch lines, expected 1" >&2; exit 1; }
    v=$(sed -n 's/^const FABLE_WEEK = \(true\|false\)$/\1/p' "$f")
    printf '%-8s %s\n' "$([ "$v" = true ] && echo fable || echo regular)" "${f#"$here"/}"
  done
  # shellcheck disable=SC1090
  ( . "$tiers"; printf '%-8s %s (WRITER_MODEL=%s WRITER_EFFORT=%s)\n' \
      "$([ "$WRITER_MODEL" = fable ] && echo fable || echo regular)" "tiers.sh" "$WRITER_MODEL" "${WRITER_EFFORT:-}" )
}

set_mode() {
  local flag=$1 model=$2 effort=$3
  status >/dev/null
  for f in "${scripts[@]}"; do
    sed -i "s/^const FABLE_WEEK = \(true\|false\)$/const FABLE_WEEK = $flag/" "$f"
  done
  sed -i "s/^WRITER_MODEL=.*$/WRITER_MODEL=$model/; s/^WRITER_EFFORT=.*$/WRITER_EFFORT=$effort/" "$tiers"
  status
  if [ -f "$here/workflow-scenarios.js" ]; then
    echo "--- the batch script's scenario check:"
    node "$here/workflow-scenarios.js" 2>&1 | tail -3
  fi
  echo "--- commit by name: ${scripts[*]#"$here"/} tiers.sh"
}

case "${1:-status}" in
  status)  status ;;
